pose: Landscape underwater master shot featuring a vibrant, stylized coral reef and marine shelf system. Bright, high-key sunlight filters down from the surface, creating shimmering turquoise and cerulean blue water with visible, soft-edged 'god-rays' illuminating the scene. The seafloor is composed of light-colored limestone nodules and fine sand, richly populated with chunky, rounded purple and orange coral structures, sea anemones, and dense patches of green marine flora. Schools of tiny, silver forage fish swim dynamically through the midground, with soft, deep-blue atmospheric haze scaling into the distant open ocean.
